# 输入文本或数字

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
```

```{r}
textInput("name","请输入您的姓名: ")
numericInput("age","请输入您的年龄: ",NA,min = 0,max = 150)
```

```{r}
#| context: server
output$result <- renderText({
  if (is.na(input$age)) {
    paste0("姓名：", input$name, "　年龄：未填写")
  } else {
    paste0("姓名：", input$name, "　年龄：", input$age, " 岁")
  }
})
verbatimTextOutput("result")
```
